note: Scripted expert for simulated sessions and tests: the answers are what a person would say, keyed by question topic. Agent code in packages/agent/src never reads this file (a test checks that no expert wording appears in the sources). All data is synthetic.

reason.text: Customer_07 asked me for it in writing, because his phone blocks pictures in our emails. So I spell the details out myself.

essentials.text: The address and the delivery window. Nothing else is essential.

guardrail.text: If I can't tell which customer an order belongs to, I stop and ask the account manager first.

scope.text: Only for him. Customer_09 asks for something similar, but I never found out why, so I just go along with it.

exception.text: Yes, an extra picture is fine as long as the details are written out.

why_stop.text: Because a wrong match would send someone else's delivery details to the wrong person.

duration.text: Until he says otherwise. The account manager hears about changes first.

correction.text: Almost. One correction: the order number goes in as well, not only the address and the window.
